info.title: Talertech POS API
info.description:
REST API backing the Talertech multi-branch POS SaaS web app — the same endpoints power the web dashboard and are intended for the Flutter mobile client.

**Auth**: sign in via `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email`. The response includes a `set-auth-token` response header — send that value back as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every subsequent request (this is how the mobile client should authenticate; web clients may instead rely on the httpOnly session cookie better-auth also sets). Try it out in this UI: click **Authorize** and paste the token.

**Response envelope**: nearly every JSON endpoint returns `{ success: true, data?: ..., message?: string, pagination?: {...} }` on success and `{ success: false, message: string, error?: string }` on failure. Endpoints that deviate (binary files, SSE streams) are noted individually.

**Pagination** (only on list endpoints that declare it): `{ page, limit, totalCount, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrev }`.

**Known limitations** (flagged here rather than silently fixed): a handful of write endpoints (`draft-orders`, `exchange-points` POST, `inventory` list/create, `purchase-orders`, `suppliers`) check for a valid session but do not enforce the trial/subscription-active gate the way most write endpoints do — see each endpoint's description. `POST /api/products/upload-image` writes to local disk and will not persist on Vercel's serverless filesystem. SSE endpoints can't be driven by a browser `EventSource` with an `Authorization` header — a mobile/native HTTP client is required.

bearerAuth.description: Token returned in the `set-auth-token` header on sign-in. Used by the Flutter mobile client on every request; web clients may instead rely on the httpOnly session cookie.

cronSecret.description: Value of the `CRON_SECRET` env var. Only enforced when NODE_ENV=production; intended for Vercel Cron only, not app clients.

Transaction.description: Full transactions row plus a few joined display fields.

SubscriptionInactive.description: Trial or subscription has expired (reason: trial_expired | subscription_expired | payment_overdue).

NotOnboarded.description: Session valid but the account hasn't finished store onboarding yet.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or not in the caller's store).

get.description:
Delegated to better-auth (`toNextJsHandler`). Exposes the full better-auth REST surface under this prefix, notably:
- `POST /api/auth/sign-up/email`
- `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email` — response includes `set-auth-token` header with the bearer token
- `POST /api/auth/sign-out`
- `GET /api/auth/get-session`

Not enumerated further here; treat as an opaque auth module. Also enables the `bearer()` plugin used for mobile auth.

post.description: Creates the transaction + line items, decrements inventory, applies member loyalty points (earn or spend via exchange items), all in one DB transaction. Broadcasts a live notification on success. Business-rule failures (insufficient stock/points, branch/product not found) surface as 500 with the thrown message, not 400, since they throw inside the DB transaction.

get.description: ⚠️ Alternative SSE implementation to /api/notifications/sse, backed by an in-memory connection registry instead of Redis. Sends `{type:'connected'}` then `{type:'heartbeat'}` every 60s. Same EventSource/Authorization header caveat applies.

post.description: Not called by app clients — iPaymu calls this directly. Documented for completeness. Verified via HMAC signature (`sha256(va + status + trx_id + apiKey)`), not a user session. On success status, updates the user's subscription (`reference_id` format `SUB|userId|plan|timestamp`).

200.description: Acknowledged (always 200 on a recognized signature, even for an unrecognized reference_id).
